d:
After a 13-year wait, GTA 6 has finally arrived, bringing gamers back to the streets of Vice City. Developed by Rockstar Games, the latest instalment follows Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos in a new story set in the fictional state of Leonida.
The launch has sparked excitement among gamers, with many revisiting childhood memories of playing earlier GTA titles. But does GTA 6 live up to the hype? Is it worth the nearly Rs 6,000 price tag? And what does its launch mean for gaming lounges in India?
